model_annotation: This donut chart displays the distribution of data across two nested categorical dimensions: “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”. The outer ring, representing standard deviation levels of ambiguity, is divided into four segments: Std: 0.0 (49.0%), Std: 0.47 (38.0%), Std: 0.82 (7.0%), and Std: 0.94 (5.0%). The inner ring, indicating maximum ambiguity values, consists of three segments: Max: 1 (47.7%), Max: 2 (39.0%), and Max: 3 (14.2%). Each segment is color-coded according to its respective legend, with darker blues corresponding to higher standard deviation values in the outer ring and lighter blues indicating higher maximum ambiguity values in the inner ring. Percentages are labeled directly on the chart for each segment, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size within each ring.
